canonical_title: Snorkel AI raises $350M as frontier labs demand complex training data and RL environments
treatment: Covered as a frontier-model training-data market signal. Reinclude only for disclosed frontier-lab customers, material revenue/profitability changes, evaluation expansion, or new data/RL-environment capabilities.
known_facts: Snorkel AI raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation.
Annualized revenue run-rate crossed about $350 million, up from roughly $20 million a year earlier, according to its CEO.
The company shifted from primarily selling software toward finished datasets and reinforcement-learning environments, using human experts plus AI automation.
Snorkel expects human input to remain necessary while synthetic and automated approaches scale data production.
reinclude_only_if: Named frontier-lab customers or contracts are disclosed.
Material technical details about RL environments, evaluation methodology, or data-generation systems are published.
Profitability or revenue changes materially from the reported trajectory.
notes: Reuters exclusive published 2026-09-22 13:02 UTC, inside the Night Lite window. Selected because it quantifies the shift toward complex expert data and RL environments for frontier training rather than merely reporting a financing round.
